documents.title: Central axis graph camera
documents.body: The native graph rotates around its central axis. Pointer drag changes yaw and pitch without making the scene orbit around an external planet.

documents.title: Orbital mechanics notes
documents.body: A satellite follows an elliptical orbit around a planet. Central gravity changes the orbital path while the planet rotates.

documents.title: Authoritative dynamic chunk boundaries
documents.body: The compiler consumes exact dynamic chunk records from structural analysis. It never reconstructs paragraphs or guesses chunk boundaries downstream.

documents.title: Editor paragraph layout
documents.body: The editor lays out visible paragraphs lazily while preserving the complete document. Presentation paragraphs do not redefine retrieval chunks.

documents.title: Correction and supersession policy
documents.body: Corrections preserve old evidence and create explicit supersession chains. Changed facts remain auditable instead of silently deleting history.

documents.title: Causal evidence requirements
documents.body: A causal candidate must cite exact evidence spans. Correlation and weak co-occurrence cannot automatically become an accepted causal relationship.

documents.title: CAPS semantic shell projection
documents.body: CAPS assigns semantic regions to nested hyperbolic shells. Structural anchors occupy dedicated depth bands while identities remain stable.

documents.title: Siegel hierarchy projection
documents.body: Siegel emphasizes hierarchy through layered vertical structure. It is distinct from the CAPS semantic shell projection.

documents.title: DiskANN mmap index
documents.body: The native ANN uses immutable mmap pages, bounded beam search, stable vector IDs, and disk-ready neighbor records.

documents.title: HNSW graph construction
documents.body: The construction graph maintains hierarchical neighbor layers and bounded candidate queues before compact publication.

documents.title: Phthalo green palette
documents.body: The shared palette uses rich phthalo green for the sidebar and saturated entity colors for editor highlights and graph nodes.

documents.title: Immutable release manifest
documents.body: A release lock records source, binary, model, configuration, artifact hashes, performance gates, and the final authority decision.

documents.title: Tea order in Rome
documents.body: User: Where did we buy tea? Assistant: You ordered jasmine green tea from the covered market in Rome on Saturday morning.

documents.title: Coffee near the station
documents.body: User: Remember my coffee stop. Assistant: You bought an espresso beside the train station before sunrise.

documents.title: Motorcycle engine repair
documents.body: User: What did Bob fix? Assistant: Bob repaired the motorcycle engine after work and replaced the cracked fuel hose.

documents.title: Bicycle tire repair
documents.body: User: Did Mira finish the bicycle? Assistant: Mira patched the rear tire but left the chain adjustment for Sunday.

documents.title: Interface color preference
documents.body: User: Keep this preference. Assistant: You prefer phthalo green accents over purple gradients in the application sidebar.

documents.title: Dinner preference
documents.body: User: Remember dinner choices. Assistant: You prefer spicy ramen and avoid sweet tomato sauce.

documents.title: Corrected project meeting
documents.body: User: The meeting moved. Assistant: Correction recorded: the Phoenix review is Thursday at three, superseding Tuesday at noon.

documents.title: Corrected flight time
documents.body: User: Update the flight. Assistant: The flight now departs Friday evening, replacing the earlier Saturday schedule.

documents.title: Nightly backup commitment
documents.body: User: What did I promise? Assistant: You committed to verify the encrypted backup every night before shutting down.

documents.title: Community garden goal
documents.body: User: Save my spring goal. Assistant: You plan to build three raised garden beds and plant herbs in April.

documents.title: Miso soup procedure
documents.body: User: How should I finish the soup? Assistant: Dissolve the miso after lowering the heat, then add scallions without boiling.

documents.title: Sourdough bread procedure
documents.body: User: Keep the baking steps. Assistant: Fold the dough, rest it overnight, and preheat the covered oven before baking.
